kjv: [saying], Blessed [be] the glory of the LORD from his place
mine: as the glory of Yahweh rose from its place
note: MT baruk kebod-YHWH "blessed be the glory" requires the KJV's supplied "saying"; a one-letter emendation to berum "when (the glory) rose" fits v. 13 (the sound of wings and wheels). I follow the emendation.
